title.zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
title.en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance

current_state.zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
current_state.en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.

updates.title_zh: Aave Labs 提议成立基金会，将品牌和知识产权纳入 DAO 监管
updates.title_en: Aave Labs Proposes Foundation to Bring Brand and IP Under DAO Oversight
updates.what_changed_zh: Aave Labs 提议创建一个开曼群岛基金会，配备独立高管，作为将 Aave 的品牌、商标、域名和代码库移交给 DAO 治理的第一阶段，实际资产转移将取决于后续治理投票。
updates.what_changed_en: Aave Labs proposed creating a Cayman Islands foundation with independent officers as a first phase toward transferring Aave's brand, trademarks, domains and codebase to DAO governance, with the actual asset transfers subject to later governance votes.

updates.title_en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Hold Protocol IP for the DAO
updates.what_changed_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
updates.what_changed_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.
updates.background_zh: Aave 是一个非托管的 DeFi 借贷协议，利率由供需算法决定，是规模最大的去中心化借贷协议之一。基金会等法律载体被普遍用于让 DAO 持有和保护商标、域名等知识产权，并与链下世界互动，同时协议仍由链上治理运行。
updates.background_en: Aave is a non-custodial DeFi lending protocol where interest rates are set algorithmically by supply and demand, and it is among the largest decentralized lending protocols. Legal wrappers such as foundations are commonly used so that a DAO can hold and protect intellectual property like trademarks and domain names and interact with the off-chain world, while on-chain governance continues to run the protocol.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 Aave 品牌与代码库的法律所有权，而非协议流动性，因此市场传导路径主要在治理与法律结构层面：提案声明 AAVE 持有者的现有投票权不变，而更清晰的法律载体可能影响交易对手、贡献者与机构参与者同协议互动的方式。ARFC 阶段本身不会改变抵押资产、上币安排或代币供应。
updates.market_impact_en: The proposal concerns the legal ownership of Aave's brand and codebase rather than protocol liquidity, so any market transmission runs through governance and legal structure: AAVE holders' existing voting rights are stated as unchanged, while a clearer legal wrapper could affect how counterparties, contributors and institutional participants engage with the protocol. The ARFC stage itself does not alter collateral, listings or token supply.
